title: A Wardrobe for the Silence
author: Silas Winterbourne
blurb: Jonah Kavanagh, a former prodigy returning to the conservatory as a janitor, keeps a careful inventory of everything unsaid. But when a song on the radio is one that was written and never recorded, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must ask the question the whole family arranged itself around before the demolition date arrives.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
